clauses.reason: Paragraph 1(a)-(b) directs OPM to coordinate priorities and exercise the President's powers under the 1941 priorities act. EO 9040 (signed 1942-01-24, no later effective date) provides that OPM "is abolished and its personnel, records, property, and funds are transferred to the War" Production Board and that the Chairman performs OPM's functions; EO 9024 had only placed OPM under the chairman's supervision ("Supervise the Office of Production Management in the performance of its responsibilities and duties"), so the clause ended on 1942-01-24 (actor: President Roosevelt).

The scope 'EO:8875#1941' is the remainder of paragraph 1 ((b) end through (d): Maritime Commission priorities and section 2(a) of the June 28, 1940 Act). EO 9040 (signed 1942-01-24, no later effective date) provides that OPM "is abolished and its personnel, records, property, and funds are transferred to the War" Production Board and that the Chairman performs OPM's functions; EO 9024 had only placed OPM under the chairman's supervision ("Supervise the Office of Production Management in the performance of its responsibilities and duties"), so the clause ended on 1942-01-24 (actor: President Roosevelt).

Paragraph 2 lets OPM act through such officials as it determines, subject to SPAB policies. EO 9040 (signed 1942-01-24, no later effective date) provides that OPM "is abolished and its personnel, records, property, and funds are transferred to the War" Production Board and that the Chairman performs OPM's functions; EO 9024 had only placed OPM under the chairman's supervision ("Supervise the Office of Production Management in the performance of its responsibilities and duties"), so the clause ended on 1942-01-24 (actor: President Roosevelt).

Paragraph 3 establishes the Supply Priorities and Allocations Board and its membership. EO 9024 (signed 1942-01-16, no later effective date) provides that the SPAB "is hereby abolished, and its personnel, records, and property transferred to the Board." (actor: President Roosevelt), and its section 2(c) gives the War Production Board chairman SPAB's powers under EO 8875; the clause therefore ended on 1942-01-16.

Paragraph 4 requires OPM to make staff and services available to the SPAB on request; with the SPAB abolished there is no board to serve. EO 9024 (signed 1942-01-16, no later effective date) provides that the SPAB "is hereby abolished, and its personnel, records, and property transferred to the Board." (actor: President Roosevelt), and its section 2(c) gives the War Production Board chairman SPAB's powers under EO 8875; the clause therefore ended on 1942-01-16.

Paragraph 5 sets the SPAB's duties on requirements and allocation policy. EO 9024 (signed 1942-01-16, no later effective date) provides that the SPAB "is hereby abolished, and its personnel, records, and property transferred to the Board." (actor: President Roosevelt), and its section 2(c) gives the War Production Board chairman SPAB's powers under EO 8875; the clause therefore ended on 1942-01-16.

Paragraph 6 requires OPM divisions to formulate priority and allocation plans for SPAB approval; the submission step lost its addressee on 1942-01-16 but the OPM duty to formulate plans continued under the chairman's supervision until OPM was abolished. EO 9040 (signed 1942-01-24, no later effective date) provides that OPM "is abolished and its personnel, records, property, and funds are transferred to the War" Production Board and that the Chairman performs OPM's functions; EO 9024 had only placed OPM under the chairman's supervision ("Supervise the Office of Production Management in the performance of its responsibilities and duties"), so the clause ended on 1942-01-24 (actor: President Roosevelt).

Paragraph 7 creates the Division of Civilian Supply within OPM. EO 9040 (signed 1942-01-24, no later effective date) provides that OPM "is abolished and its personnel, records, property, and funds are transferred to the War" Production Board and that the Chairman performs OPM's functions; EO 9024 had only placed OPM under the chairman's supervision ("Supervise the Office of Production Management in the performance of its responsibilities and duties"), so the clause ended on 1942-01-24 (actor: President Roosevelt).

Paragraph 8 states that the title of the Office of Price Administration and Civilian Supply "is hereby changed to Office of Price Administration." This is a self-executing one-time act performed on signing, 1941-08-28 (no later effective date); the new name is a surviving consequence, not a continuing command.

Paragraph 9 provides that nothing in the order is construed to include the power to determine disposition of defense articles to foreign governments under the Lend-Lease Act. It limits the powers delegated by the order and ended with the last of them, when OPM was abolished by EO 9040 (1942-01-24; SPAB's powers had gone on 1942-01-16).
Paragraph 10 states that the Priorities Board of OPM described in paragraph 5 of EO 8629 "is hereby abolished." This is a self-executing one-time act performed on signing, 1941-08-28.

Paragraph 11 amends EO 8629 and EO 8734 accordingly and rescinds conflicting provisions of other Executive orders. These amendments and rescissions were made on signing, 1941-08-28, and are one-time acts (the amended text of those orders is a surviving consequence).

research_rationale:
EO 8875 (signed 1941-08-28, 6 FR 4483) delegated priority powers to the Office of Production Management (OPM) (paragraphs 1, 2, 4, 6, 7), created the Supply Priorities and Allocations Board (SPAB) (paragraphs 3, 5), renamed the Office of Price Administration and Civilian Supply (8), limited its reach (9), abolished the OPM Priorities Board (10) and amended/rescinded conflicting provisions of EO 8629 and EO 8734 (11). EO 9024 (signed 1942-01-16; 7 FR 329) says "is hereby abolished, and its personnel, records, and property transferred to the Board." of the SPAB, so the SPAB clauses (3, 4, 5) ended on 1942-01-16; it also gives the War Production Board chairman SPAB's powers under EO 8875 and leaves OPM in being under the chairman's supervision. EO 9040 (signed 1942-01-24; 7 FR 527) provides that OPM "is abolished and its personnel, records, property, and funds are transferred to the War" Production Board and that the Chairman performs OPM's functions, so the OPM clauses (1, 2, 6, 7) and the order's reach limit (9) ended on 1942-01-24, the latest clause end and the whole-order end. Paragraphs 8, 10 and 11 are self-executing one-time acts completed on signing 1941-08-28. The dossier segmentation splits paragraph 1 at the odd scope 'EO:8875#1941' (the rest of 1(b)-(d)); the two scopes together are paragraph 1, and the inventory is otherwise complete (paragraphs 1-11). Both later orders have no later effective-date clause, so signing dates are used. Status proposal: no.
